title: 第3章 凡人仙缘第4章 神奇的梦
lines: 李骏被烟熏得黑乎乎的，站在书荷旁，后面被家人领了回去。
他爹李三看到李骏这样，啥也没问，沉默如父，作为母亲的徐花给灰头土脸的李骏洗澡去。
李骏抱着怀里的松鼠，和它一起小心翼翼，坐进澡盆里。
说是澡盆，其实就是个家里的提水桶，李骏就在母亲徐花的擦拭下，清洁了身子，端了碗饭菜，回屋吃饭了。
对于李骏带一些小动物回家，徐花早就见怪不怪了，但是那松鼠，也-免不了被徐花一顿揉搓，徐花就是害怕不干净。
洗干净以后，这松鼠恢复了其本来面目，是一只渐银色的松鼠。
李骏小时候，看过褐色，棕色的，这渐银色的还真没看过。
而这渐银色松鼠似乎是筋疲力尽，刚在洗澡时候，也不怎么蹦跶，现在直接倒在李骏的床头，死死睡去。
而吃完晚饭的李骏，也是困乏，抱着松鼠，也入了眠，星光从窗外撒入，照的松鼠银光微颤。
在屋子内堂，徐花做着手工，在李三旁边念叨。
沉默如山的李三开口了，“这娃子，火堆里面跑出来，还抓了只松鼠...”
“三哥，这娃子这不是跟你学的，猎户哪有空手归的。”
徐花放下手中的手工，转身收拾着一些行李。
李三深深抽了口土烟。
“他怎么不把书本带出来，那些书全部烧在里面了，就怕这松鼠是他自己带去学堂的，不读书就是不务正业，看我明天就把那床头的松鼠给办了！”
“也别太得劲，你这样做，忘了泽华么？已经两年不回家了。”
“不回就不回，家里少个吃饭的嘴不也挺好的么？他们都应该感谢我，是我给他们这条命，把他们拉扯大的。”
李三漫不经心说道。
“我明早去西平城里去看看泽华，毕竟我是孩子的妈，他不见你，难道还不见我么？”
徐花坐在的厅堂一边的凳子上，满脸忧愁。
“泽华？哼，不孝子！
真当我只有他一个儿子么？大不了再生几个呗。
总有一个出息的。”
“你，你，怎么能这般说话。”
徐花有点恼怒，转念一说，“隔壁陈婶说，西平城里有几个庙宇，有些头发剃干净了的修士，被称呼为和尚，听说他们庙里有神明叫什么菩萨，我哪天诚心去拜拜，说不定托他老人家的福，孩子学业有成，就出息了。”
李三不以为意，对于松村的村民而言，神明，信仰，似乎不是那么上头，也就是近百年，有一些村民和外界联络多了，接受了一些习俗，那些村民对外界庙宇颇为感兴趣。
“拜归拜，别拿钱供奉那些土捏的泥巴。”
说罢，李三径直走出门去，躺在了院内的躺椅上，拿着蒲扇，呼呼大睡起来。
清晨破晓，鸡鸣声起，整个荷叶塘升起了袅袅炊烟，不少农户开始做早饭了。
泥路子上，出现了零星人影，在匆匆赶路着。
李骏醒来第一件事，就是看一眼床头的松鼠。
床头空无一物，松鼠早已不知所踪，而唯独留下一个棕色带着点微银的松果，在床边。
content_en:
Li Jun, blackened by the smoke, stood next to Shu He and was taken back by his family.
His father, Li San, saw Li Jun like this and didn't ask anything. He was as silent as a father. As a mother, Xu Hua gave the disgraced Li Jun a bath.
Li Jun held the squirrel in his arms and carefully sat in the bathtub with it.
It was said to be a bathtub, but it was actually a bucket at home. Li Jun cleaned himself with his mother Xu Hua's wipes, took a bowl of food, and went back to the house to eat.
Xu Hua had long been accustomed to Li Jun bringing some small animals home, but the squirrel was inevitably rubbed by Xu Hua. Xu Hua was just afraid that it would be unclean.
After cleaning, the squirrel returned to its original appearance, a squirrel that turned silver.
When Li Jun was a child, he had seen brown ones, but he had never seen this gradually silver one.
The silvery squirrel seemed to be exhausted. He didn't jump much when he took a bath. Now he fell directly on Li Jun's bed and fell asleep.
After dinner, Li Jun was also sleepy. He hugged the squirrel and fell asleep. Starlight poured in from the window, making the squirrel tremble slightly with its silver light.
In the inner hall of the house, Xu Hua was doing handwork and talking next to Li San.
Li San, who was as silent as a mountain, spoke, "This kid ran out of the fire and caught a squirrel..."
"Third brother, this kid didn't learn this from you. How can an Orion return empty-handed?"
Xu Hua put down her handiwork and turned around to pack some luggage.
Li San took a deep breath of native cigarette.
"Why didn't he bring the books out? All those books were burned inside. He was afraid that he brought the squirrel to the school by himself. If he doesn't study, he is not doing his job properly. Look, I will take care of the squirrel on the bedside tomorrow!"
"Don't be too proud. Are you forgetting Zehua? You haven't been home for two years."
"If you don't come back, you won't come back. Wouldn't it be nice to have less people to eat in the family? They should all thank me. It's me who gave them this life and raised them up."
Li San said casually.
"I will go to Xiping City to see Zehua tomorrow morning. After all, I am the child's mother. If he doesn't see you, why doesn't he see me?"
Xu Hua was sitting on a stool on the side of the hall, her face full of sadness.
"Zehua? Humph, you are an unfilial son!
Do you really think I only have a son? At best, I'll have a few more.
There's always someone out there. "
"You, you, how can you talk like this."
Xu Hua was a little angry and then thought about it, "Aunt Chen next door said that there are several temples in Xiping City. Some monks with clean shaven heads are called monks. I heard that there are gods in their temples called Bodhisattva. If I sincerely go to worship him one day, maybe thanks to the blessing of this old man, my child will succeed in school and be successful."
Li San didn't take it seriously. For the villagers in Songcun, gods and beliefs didn't seem to be that important. In the past hundred years, some villagers had more contact with the outside world and accepted some customs. Those villagers were quite interested in external temples.
"Bless you, please, don't use money to worship those clays."
After that, Li San went straight out the door, lay down on the deck chair in the courtyard, held a cattail leaf fan, and fell asleep.
At dawn in the morning, the cock crows, smoke rises from the lotus leaf pond, and many farmers start to make breakfast.
On the dirt road, scattered figures appeared, hurrying along.
The first thing Li Jun did when he woke up was to take a look at the squirrel on the bedside.
There was nothing at the head of the bed, the squirrel had long since disappeared, and only a brown pine cone with a hint of silver was left beside the bed.
title_en: Chapter 3 Mortal Immortal Fate Chapter 4 Magical Dream
